short.text: Jason Babin, a veteran pass rusher and in the staff's view a viable NFL starter, led Jacksonville's edge rotation in 2013 and was active for all {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games and both playoff games. In the 2013 camp he was the leading source of edge pressure in the rotation, rushing with get-off, bend and a useful plan. His run defense at the point of attack, block shedding and contain discipline were below his value as a rusher.

transactions.text: Signed a five-year contract with Philadelphia
Claimed off waivers by Jacksonville, carrying his Philadelphia contract
Traded by Jacksonville to Miami, with Jacksonville's 2017 seventh-round pick, for Miami's 2015 third-round pick
